record.interface_detail: OAI-PMH / EDM metadata submission through an aggregator. Not an object store.
record.limits_note: Scope test is the gate: 'Your collection is about Europe; made by a European or a European community; or owned by a European institution.' Plus aggregator intermediation, so an individual cannot submit even in-scope material directly.
record.reliability_note: metadata-only even for accredited institutions, so it can never hold bytes.

evidence.proved: Step 2 Requirements: 'The scope of your collection aligns with the Europeana Content Strategy. Your collection is about Europe; made by a European or a European community; or owned by a European institution.'
the framework is written for data partners/aggregators supplying 'your online collection', i.e. objects remain on the partner's host
